_comment: CARD-RENDER-AUDIT baselines — recorded 2026-07-28 (corpus max_id=14245) from the two deterministic windows the scanner renders: mod14 (id%14==0, n=1016) and latest500 (id>max_id-500, n~460). Ceiling classes are ingest artefacts we live with: the check WARNS only when a rate rises past baseline+tol — the null-verdict-fossil / spine-artifact growth pattern. tol is roughly 3-5x the binomial sigma of the rate at the window's n, so deterministic drift noise never trips it but a systemic increase does; latest500 tolerances are wider because its n is smaller and its content mix moves with the news cycle. snake_case_identifier is a ceiling only because a residue still exists (possible_redirect risk flags; news_context/primary_source/fact_check in evidence sources) — after that fix, move it to the scanner's ZERO list and delete it here. Zero classes are not listed: they must be zero, always, in every window.

latest500._note: bullet_char is SATURATED in this window (recent ingest is press-release-heavy); it cannot meaningfully grow here, so its growth signal is the mod14 window's job
